lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # coomer

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: coomer is a frozen full-screen zoom overlay for macOS screen shares. A Rust binary drives AppKit through the `objc2` crates; Core Graphics paints the frozen **Screenshot**. It renders as a normal window, so meeting apps capture it, unlike macOS Accessibility Zoom.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Prefer simple systems and small diffs. Fight scope creep; honor the dev's intent minimally.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Glossary

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Read [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md) before naming anything. It is the ubiquitous language (Overlay, Overlay Session, Screenshot, HUD, Flashlight, Zoom vs Zoom Meeting App, ...) and lists the words to avoid. Use those terms in code, comments, issues, and PRs.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: When this file speaks:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `you` is the agent reading this file and changing coomer.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `user` is the person presenting with coomer during a **Screen Share**.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## How it works

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: One launch is one **Overlay Session**. `app::run` terminates the previous session through `~/.coomer/pid` (**Replacement Launch**), checks **Screen Recording Permission**, captures the display under the pointer, and opens a borderless screen-saver-level window on that screen. A local `NSEvent` monitor in `input` maps events to `OverlayIntent`s; `OverlaySession` applies them and returns a `SessionOutcome` (redraw, animate, quit). A `CADisplayLink` drives the Fade In and Flashlight animations. `render` draws a session snapshot with Core Graphics; the HUD is AppKit glass views mounted on top.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Where code lives

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `src/app.rs` - launch flow, pidfile, `NSApplication` setup

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `src/session.rs` - `OverlaySession`: Zoom, Panning, Flashlight, animation state and tuning constants. No AppKit views.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `src/overlay.rs` - `CoomerWindow` / `CoomerView`, display link, session ownership on the main thread

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `src/input.rs` - key codes, event monitor, `OverlayIntent`; `src/render.rs` - Core Graphics drawing

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `src/hud.rs` - HUD layout, notch offset, hide-when-obstructing, settle animation

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `src/capture.rs` - **Display Capture**; `src/permissions.rs` - Screen Recording Permission flow

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `packaging/Info.plist` + `scripts/package-app.sh` - **Dock-less Agent** bundle; `raycast/` - **Raycast Trigger**

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `.agents/skills/` - `comprehende`, installed from `matemolnar8/comprehende` via the `skills` CLI (`skills-lock.json`), so update it with `npx skills update`, never by hand; and `pages`, a repo-owned skill with its own publish script. `.claude/skills` symlinks here.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Footguns

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. **Launching takes over the screen.** The Overlay covers the display at screen-saver level and grabs input. A Replacement Launch also kills whatever session the user has open. Ask before you run the binary or the bundle. If you started one, end it with `q`/`Esc` or by the PID you tracked.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. **Every exit path must clean up.** `app::cleanup_pidfile` runs on normal quit and on the permission-denied exit. A new exit path that skips it leaves a stale pidfile behind.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 3. **Main thread only.** AppKit objects need a `MainThreadMarker`. Session state lives in a main-thread `thread_local!` in `overlay.rs`; do not reach for `Mutex`, `static mut`, or threads to share it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Hit every surface

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The common defect is a change that works on the path you tested and breaks another. Before calling work done, say which applied:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Displays.** Multiple monitors, notched and non-notched screens, different backing scale factors. Capture and window frame must agree on the screen under the pointer.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Inputs.** Keyboard and pointer, trackpad (precise) and wheel (line) scrolling, `Command`+scroll. Keep the README controls table in sync with `input.rs`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Reverse states.** Flashlight on needs off, Zoom in needs out, and **Reset** restores defaults for everything you added.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Motion.** Respect Reduce Motion (see `hud.rs`). No continuous repaint when nothing animates; pause the display link.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - **Screen Share.** The Overlay must stay capturable by meeting apps. Do not switch to window types or APIs that exclude it from capture.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Taste

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Prefer AppKit views for native UI affordances; keep Core Graphics rendering focused on the frozen image and its effects.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - In `objc2` code, avoid `as_super()` unless a real superclass coercion or owned upcast is needed.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Derive HUD and layout geometry from named constants, not unexplained magic numbers.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - When AppKit docs suggest event APIs, first decide whether the feature is really event-driven or just geometry and state.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Keep logic that can be pure in `session.rs` or small functions, and unit test it there.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Verifying

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Smallest proof the change works: `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, `cargo test`, `cargo build --release`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - For a visible change, do one pass in the real Overlay after asking (see Footguns). The packaged app needs its own Screen Recording grant.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Pull requests

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Open a PR only when asked, or when requested feature work is ready under an approved plan.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Conventional titles, plain language: `fix(hud): hide pill when flashlight covers it`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Body: the problem in a sentence or two, then how you fixed it, then which checks passed. End with the model and harness that did the work.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Review the diff with the `comprehende` skill (base is the merge-base with `main`, head is the branch tip), `export` it, then host the export with the `pages` skill using `--pr <number>`. Put the printed URL in the PR body. When the PR gets new commits, refresh the review and publish again to the same URL.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Visual changes need before/after screenshots; motion needs a short video. Upload evidence to GitHub; do not commit PR-only images.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - One request is one PR.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Documentation

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Most code changes do not need a docs change. Agents can read the code.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `README.md` is for users: controls, build, permissions, Raycast. Change it when user-visible behavior changes.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `CONTEXT.md` is the glossary. Add a term only when a new user-facing concept appears; keep the "Avoid" lines current.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not enumerate fields, narrate control flow, or keep file catalogs. When a documented decision changes, rewrite it in place; do not append a second account.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Plans and work artifacts

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not commit plans, research notes, or scratch files. Keep them outside the worktree.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - GitHub Issues on `matemolnar8/coomer` are the tracker; use `gh`. A merged PR is the implementation record.
